FROM order_items i

records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.chart_reading: 3 项中最高是 Paper(806.32),其次 Fasteners(246.47),最低 Labels(21.86),最高约为最低的 36.9 倍。按 total_sales 计,最高是 Paper(1,816.57)。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit) * 1.0 / SUM(i.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE i.sales IS NOT NULL AND i.profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC
LIMIT 3;

records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit)/SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS margin FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY margin ASC

records.question: Corporate 客户在 2014 年下了多少张订单,平均每张订单金额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt,
       SUM(t.amt) AS total_sales,
       SUM(t.amt) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS avg_order_amt
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(sales) AS amt FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t ON t.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014'

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
WITH t AS (SELECT sales FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM t),
o AS (SELECT sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn FROM t)
SELECT AVG(sales) AS median_sales FROM o, n WHERE rn IN ((c + 1) / 2, (c + 2) / 2)
